method: Dynamic theme priority is based on WHAT'S NEW and WHAT MATTERS MOST NOW. Historical importance alone does not keep a theme near the top. Weekend headlines can rerank mechanism/freshness, but Friday equity closes remain the valid price references until markets reopen.

whatsNewNow: U.S. forces struck three Iranian oil tankers after missile attacks on U.S. Navy vessels; Iran warned shipping and claimed retaliation. Direct oil-transport risk is now the freshest market mechanism.
Reuters reported Brent around $96.28 during the escalation, while U.S. Labor Day gasoline is expected around a record $4.03/gal and diesel remains near records.
Iraq says oil export capacity is back above 3 million bpd and is pursuing Mediterranean pipeline routes, creating a material scarcity-offset/rerouting theme rather than a one-way Hormuz thesis.
TCS/HyperVault and partners plan up to roughly $7.4B for a 1GW AI data-centre campus in Telangana, reinforcing global power/grid/switchgear/cooling demand.
No new cash equity/Treasury session exists over the weekend; Sep 4 prices/yields remain the valid technical reference rather than fabricated weekend ticks.
whatMattersMostNow: Hormuz/refined-product inflation after direct tanker strikes

newThemes.name: Resilient Jobs/Services + Hot Inflation / Fed & Long-End Risk
newThemes.summary: Strong August payrolls and services demand keep the Fed/long-end hurdle high even before the weekend oil shock.
newThemes.whyNow: NFP +162k, unemployment 4.1%, Services PMI 55.4 and Prices 72.6.
newThemes.marketTransmission: Higher discount rates and financing costs favor cash-generative pricing-power businesses over leveraged duration.
newThemes.confirmation: PPI/CPI remain sticky and yields stay high.
newThemes.invalidation: Disinflation and weaker labor push real/nominal yields down durably.
newThemes.nextTest: Sep 10 PPI, Sep 11 CPI, Sep 15-16 FOMC.
newThemes.watchlistAction: Favor current cash flow and funded backlog.

newThemes.name: Energy Security Rerouting / Alternative Export Corridors
newThemes.summary: High Gulf risk is accelerating efforts to route oil around Hormuz through Mediterranean, Americas and other alternatives.
newThemes.whyNow: Iraq says export capacity is above 3 mbpd and is pursuing routes toward Ceyhan/Banias while direct tanker attacks make chokepoint dependence more costly.
newThemes.marketTransmission: Supports storage, terminals, pipelines, contracted LNG and non-Hormuz supply while capping extreme Gulf scarcity over time.
newThemes.confirmation: Alternative export capacity and long-term contracting keep rising.
newThemes.invalidation: Rapid Hormuz normalization removes rerouting urgency.
newThemes.nextTest: Iraq export volumes/pipeline milestones, Americas exports, LNG contracts.
newThemes.watchlistAction: Strengthen DIALOG/infrastructure research; do not add duplicate crude beta.

refining-product-inflation.whyNow: Direct U.S. strikes on three Iranian oil tankers and Iranian retaliatory shipping threats escalate the mechanism from chokepoint friction to direct oil-transport risk. Labor Day gasoline is expected around a record $4.03/gal and diesel remains near record levels.
refining-product-inflation.marketTransmission: Crude/product risk premium, freight and consumer inflation rise; integrated/refining/shipping benefit until demand destruction/policy response dominates.
refining-product-inflation.confirmation: Further attacks, low Hormuz transit and persistent product tightness.
refining-product-inflation.invalidation: Durable ceasefire, normalized tanker traffic and inventory rebuild.
refining-product-inflation.nextTest: Sunday/Monday oil reaction, Hormuz traffic, EIA Sep 10.
refining-product-inflation.watchlistAction: Prefer XOM/quality refiners and storage/logistics; no geopolitical chase.

ai-physical-bottlenecks.whyNow: A newly announced 1GW TCS/HyperVault AI campus broadens the capex evidence geographically on top of ISM transmission/generation purchasing signals.
ai-physical-bottlenecks.marketTransmission: Supports power equipment, contractors, switchgear, microgrids, cooling and generation.
ai-physical-bottlenecks.invalidation: Funded-load cancellations begin reducing supplier backlog.
ai-physical-bottlenecks.watchlistAction: Keep PWR/ETN/GEV/VRT high quality; maintain valuation discipline.

copper-scarcity-squeeze-risk.whyNow: Tariff-driven U.S. stockpiling continues to thin ex-US visible copper buffers while grid/electrification demand remains firm.
copper-scarcity-squeeze-risk.marketTransmission: Supports miners but raises cable/transformer/equipment costs.
copper-scarcity-squeeze-risk.invalidation: Tariff arbitrage unwinds and ex-US stocks rebuild.

ai-time-to-power-microgrids.whyNow: Large AI campuses increasingly need onsite/grid-hybrid solutions to avoid interconnection delays.
ai-time-to-power-microgrids.nextTest: Microgrid awards and large-load connection timelines.

ai-load-quality-ghost-demand.whyNow: AI buildout is broadening but high rates keep funded demand, deposits and named customers essential.
ai-load-quality-ghost-demand.marketTransmission: Rewards real backlog and penalizes speculative MW queues/pre-revenue developers.
ai-load-quality-ghost-demand.confirmation: Utilities keep deposit/funding screens and suppliers retain order quality.
ai-load-quality-ghost-demand.invalidation: Speculative queues convert broadly to funded projects.
ai-load-quality-ghost-demand.nextTest: Utility audits, deposits, cancellations and supplier FCF.

fertilizer-feedstock-divergence.whyNow: Fuel/freight remain inflationary, but farm-input demand is not uniformly inelastic.
fertilizer-feedstock-divergence.marketTransmission: Nitrogen/premium genetics are harder to defer; potash/phosphate and machinery more deferrable.
fertilizer-feedstock-divergence.invalidation: Farm margins collapse and application falls.
fertilizer-feedstock-divergence.nextTest: Crop/input ratios, urea/ammonia and application rates.

software-relative-strength.whyNow: Selected vendors show real AI consumption/ARR, but high rates prevent blanket SaaS rerating.
software-relative-strength.confirmation: AI products expand cash conversion across multiple vendors.
software-relative-strength.invalidation: Growth slows while valuations remain high.
software-relative-strength.watchlistAction: Use pullbacks; do not chase gaps.

uranium-nuclear-fuel.whyNow: Fuel-cycle scarcity remains investable but has less fresh transmission than energy/rates/grid/copper this weekend.
uranium-nuclear-fuel.marketTransmission: Supports operating uranium/fuel names; high rates penalize concept-stage reactors.

gold-precious-metals-reconfirmation.whyNow: Weekend geopolitics supports hedging, but no new cash gold close exists and high real yields remain a headwind.
gold-precious-metals-reconfirmation.marketTransmission: Safe-haven/fiscal demand competes with USD/real-yield pressure.
gold-precious-metals-reconfirmation.invalidation: Real yields/USD break higher and bullion loses support.
gold-precious-metals-reconfirmation.nextTest: Monday gold reaction, PPI/CPI, real yields.

energy-security-americas-lng.whyNow: Americas/LNG remains relevant but is now one branch of a broader alternative-export-corridor mechanism.
energy-security-americas-lng.confirmation: Long-term contracts and non-Gulf flows keep rising.
energy-security-americas-lng.invalidation: Rapid route normalization and LNG oversupply.

ai-financing-cash-conversion.whyNow: Funding quality remains a gate but has less fresh evidence than physical orders or energy shock.
ai-financing-cash-conversion.marketTransmission: Separates funded backlog from speculative capex.

water-food-energy-collision.watchlistAction: VMI/XYL/ECL remain differentiated; no fresh promotion.

rubber-acreage-squeeze.watchlistAction: Background only until fresh earnings/price transmission appears.

personalized-oncology.watchlistAction: Outside current Power Stack market-significance hierarchy.
